items.scope: Vulnerabilities discovered in Extreme Networks, Inc.’s products and services.
Zyxel products issues only.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Vulnerabilities identified in Wiz products, and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Wiz that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All CrowdStrike products.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Gallagher security products only.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
Omron Group companies’ Industrial Automation, Healthcare, Social Systems, Device & Module Solutions issues only.
Gridware software, services, and infrastructure issues, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Gridware researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
AxxonSoft products and solutions, Abetechs GmbH products and solutions (GRUNDIG security products, and C-WERK software solutions).
WordPress Plugins, Themes, and Core Vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, the Wordfence/Defiant team.
All vulnerabilities on software products that our company provides, including KNIME Analytics Platform, KNIME Server, and KNIME Hub.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Pure Storage products only.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SBA Research or reported to SBA Research by partner organizations that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Radiometer products only.
Vulnerabilities in Commvault SaaS and software products only.
Lexmark products only.
All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and ProLeiT.

Vulnerabilities in software, services, and infrastructure owned and managed by Spartans Security, and vulnerabilities researched and found by Spartans Security in third-party products that are not part of another CNA's scope.
All Qualys products and vulnerabilities discovered by Qualys that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Projects listed on its Alibaba GitHub website only.
Solidigm branded products and technologies.

All F5 products and services, commercial and open source, which have not yet reached End of Technical Support (EoTS). All legacy acquisition products and brands including, but not limited to, NGINX, Shape Security, Volterra, and Threat Stack. F5 does not issue CVEs for products which are no longer supported.
Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.
OPPO devices only.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Vivo issues only.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by Project Black that are not within another CNA’s scope.
All Temporal Technologies software.
Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Cryptographic issues found in wolfSSL products.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).
AMD branded products and technologies only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Yugabyte products only.

Samsung TV & Appliance products, Samsung-owned open source projects listed on https://github.com/Samsung/, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Samsung that are not in another CNA’s scope. Vulnerabilities affecting end-of-life/end-of-service products are in scope. The following categories of Samsung Products are in scope: Internet-connected home appliances, B2C product (smart TV, smart monitor, soundbar, and projector), and B2B products (digital signage, interactive display, and kiosk).

All NortonLifeLock product issues only.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
